findings.source_quote: “a son of the commandment” and “a daughter of the commandment”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “आज्ञा का पुत्र” with “आज्ञा का बेटा” (or “आज्ञा का पुत्र”) and, importantly, replace “आज्ञा की पुत्री” only if needed for idiom; the current wording conveys the meanings. However, revise the surrounding translation to preserve the source’s claim that the boy was considered under the law and responsible for his own actions; no change to that portion is needed.
